title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting in models. It adds a penalty to the loss function to discourage complex models. Can you think of how this might affect the model's variance?

title: L2 Regularization and Variance
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients. Consider how this might impact the flexibility of the model and its variance.

title: Effect of L2 Regularization
text: What is the effect of L2 regularization on model variance?
